_why: #100 defect B: the Agent-tool leg has a lower ceiling than either CLI and nothing named that axis; the tier must fire above ~700 KB and print the layout.

mutations.name: agent-tool-tier-never-fires
mutations._mechanism: size_status=unverified (a PANE figure) is again the only size signal; a 740 KB prompt kills an Opus leg with no warning.

mutations.name: layout-drops-the-repeated-contract
mutations._mechanism: The tail contract block is folded into the last document's range, so a windowed leg briefed by these ranges never sees the repeated contract.
mutations.find:
starts.append(("contract (repeated)" if seen_contract else "contract", i))
            seen_contract = True

mutations.name: the-tier-constant-is-raised-past-the-measured-kill-size
mutations._mechanism: Nothing pinned the figure, so a constant of 1 MB (or 100 KB) stayed ALL_CAUGHT-clean while the 740 KB prompt that actually killed an Agent-tool leg passed unwarned.
